development.success: native goal AND no finger contact for 5 consecutive controls
development.label: previously observed development matrix, not blind heldout

retention.label: small prior-task regression suite, not all 40 tasks

selection: Require >10/12 development total, >2/4 placement recovery, empty/offset not below 4/4 each, all 8 old tasks pass; no panel replacement automatically. Otherwise reject promotion.
quarantined: Recovery heldout source IDs 10..13 not used for training or selection; no new PPO in this experiment
transfer_limit: Human demonstrations are LIBERO spatial task 8 (public task 36), whereas frozen recovery evaluation is LIBERO goal task 8. Same robot/action/camera contract, different scene and prompt. This is cross-scene transfer, not matched-scene DAgger; improvement is not assumed. No relabeling of spatial demonstrations as goal demonstrations.
